verdict.rationale: Numeral ships an official MCP server that lets AI agents query nexus, filings, transactions, etc. via natural-language questions, and provides Claude skills to teach agents API integration — both support natural-language/agentic operation. However, this is an agent-facing capability layered on top of a developer API rather than a native natural-language interface for end users themselves; there's no evidence of a chat/NL UI for non-technical users. Missing for 10: first-party evidence of a direct end-user natural-language interface (not just agent/MCP tooling), independent corroboration of MCP usage in practice.
